title: Yummy VS Code Color Theme
description: Structural JSON Schema for VS Code-compatible Color Theme files. The schema follows Microsoft's Color Theme and semantic token styling definitions while keeping workbench color identifiers extensible.

colors.description: Workbench/UI colors. Yummy's Application Theme adapter consumes this section.

tokenColors.description: TextMate syntax highlighting rules, or a relative path to a tmTheme file.

semanticHighlighting.description: Whether the theme enables semantic highlighting.

semanticTokenColors.description: Semantic token selectors and their styles. Yummy's Editor Theme adapter consumes this section when semantic highlighting is supported.

workbenchColors.description: VS Code workbench color identifiers. Unknown identifiers are accepted so themes remain forward-compatible; Yummy applies only identifiers it implements.

textMateTokenSettings.description: Colors and styles for a TextMate token rule.

background.description: Deprecated by VS Code for token rules; retained for compatibility with source theme files.

fontStyle.description: A space-separated combination of italic, bold, underline, and strikethrough. An empty string clears inherited styles.

fontSize.description: Font size multiplier for the token.

lineHeight.description: Line height multiplier for the token.

scope.description: TextMate scope selector. A selector may be a single string or an array of strings.

semanticTokenStyle.description: Style for a semantic token selector.

background.description: Deprecated by VS Code for semantic token styles; retained for compatibility with source theme files.

fontStyle.description: A space-separated combination of italic, bold, underline, and strikethrough. An empty string clears all styles.

semanticTokenStyleValue.description: A hexadecimal color or a style object.

semanticTokenColors.description: Selectors use the VS Code form tokenType.modifier:language. The wildcard token type is also supported.

workbenchColorValue.description: A hexadecimal color or the VS Code default-color sentinel.
